title: A Long Carry
summary: Kit Seam wants 4 cut blocks carried from the far end of Skarholm to Helm Tallis at the ore yard before the foreman files his tally.
offer_text: "The cut blocks are by my door and Helm Tallis is waiting at the ore yard. It is a long walk and I have a bad knee. Take them over before the foreman files his tally."

objectives.text: Take 4 cut blocks from outside Kit's door
Hand the cut blocks to Helm Tallis
